target: forge.sh — a token that exists only in ./.env (FORGE_TOKEN, then GITLAB_TOKEN) is used but appears in no argv log and no file other than .env
cmd:
. "$FIXTURES/forge/setup.sh"; fx_init
fx_remote https://gitlab.example.test/grp/proj.git
B="/api/v4/projects/grp%2Fproj/merge_requests"
fx_http "GET $B?source_branch=feat&state=opened" 200 '[]'
fx_http "POST $B" 201 '{"iid":3,"web_url":"https://gitlab.example.test/grp/proj/-/merge_requests/3"}'
run1() { # LABEL ENVLINE TOKEN
  fx_reqs_clear; printf '%s\n' "$2" > .env; export FORGE_MOCK_EXPECT_TOKEN="$3"
  fx_run pr-create --head feat --base main --title T --body-file body.md
  echo "$1_auth=$(tail -1 "$FORGE_MOCK_DIR/requests.log" 2>/dev/null | grep -o 'auth=[a-z]*' | cut -d= -f2)"
  echo "$1_match=$(tail -1 "$FORGE_MOCK_DIR/token-match.log" 2>/dev/null)"
  echo "$1_$(fx_tokscan "$3")"
}
run1 forge "FORGE_TOKEN=glpat-FAKE-not-a-real-token-0005" glpat-FAKE-not-a-real-token-0005
run1 gitlab "GITLAB_TOKEN=glpat-FAKE-not-a-real-token-0006" glpat-FAKE-not-a-real-token-0006
fx_done
